'''Sport Club Poltava''' ({{langx|uk|Спортивний клуб «Полтава»}}) is a professional Ukrainian [[association football|football]] club from the city of [[Poltava]]. The club will play in the [[Ukrainian First League]] in 2026-27, following relegation from the [[Ukrainian Premier League]]."}}
